description: Nothing's actually broken that hitting won't briefly fix. Do the rounds with a wrench: bang the pipes at Ironside Street, Meltwater Row, and Foundry Way until the gauges twitch. That's the whole job. 15₵.
name: Percussive Maintenance

emotes: {who} whacks a dead pipe at Ironside Street and watches a gauge flicker back to a lie.
{who} gives the junction a rhythmic thumping, ear cocked for the specific clunk that means 'fine.'
{who} kicks a valve that a wrench couldn't move, and it moves. Percussion works.
{who} raps down the run of pipe in Meltwater Row, chasing a hiss to its source and clobbering it.
{who} hits a manifold twice, the second time out of spite, and the pressure holds.
{who} presses an ear to cold metal, hears nothing good, and hits it anyway.
{who} finishes the round at Foundry Way, wrench ringing off the last stubborn coupling.
{who} thumps a compressor until it coughs, catches, and pretends to work for another day.
{who} steps back, listens to the whole system rattle in rough harmony, and calls it repaired.
